AC-A1: JSON with whitespace, binary, urlencoded, gzip (still compressed) byte-exact.
AC-A2: both directions with body(Map.class); form("a") on JSON then bodyStream returns the whole body.
AC-A3: chunked over rawBodyLimit -> BodyTooLargeException at the crossing read; unwrapped -> 413.
AC-A4: TinyHttpd [x-a, x-b] and three pairs in order/case; servlet [x-a, x-b], values 1,2,3 with x-a 1 then 2; UnsupportedOperationException on modification.
AC-A5: two Set-Cookie lines received; header still replaces.

AC-A6: non-null empty stream, same object twice, bodyStream(2048) -> IllegalStateException, 1 byte read -> BodyAlreadyConsumedException, 32 KiB unread body with keep-alive next request served (within 64 KiB maxDrainBytes; TinyHttpd.java:270 default 64*1024).
AC-A7: declared Content-Length over rawBodyLimit -> HttpException 413 from the bodyStream call before any byte is read.
AC-A8: CR, LF, NUL, U+0100 rejected like res.header (also DEL).
AC-A9: in= counts bytes read through bodyStream.
AC-A10: rawBodyLimit 1 MiB; bodyStream(2 MiB) reads 1.5 MiB (1572864); bodyStream(1024) throws at byte 1025; bodyStream(0) IAE.
AC-A11: none/hops 0/empty CIDR false; hops 1 and trustProxy(true) true; trustProxyCidrs("10.0.0.0/8") only inside.
AC-A12: disconnect (real socket) or res.abort -> once; never on normal completion; immediate after abort; later listener runs after an earlier throws.
AC-A13: no Content-Type + Content-Length: 5; HEAD/304 Content-Length: 5 no body; 204 neither; -1 unknown length; -2 IAE; 3-byte stream for 5 aborts; no Cache-Control under defaultCache.
AC-A14: empty and HTAB true; CR, LF, NUL, DEL, U+0100 false.
A in naruserve-api, B in naruserve-proxy; A-4..A-7 public so the module needs no internal.
App default rawBodyLimit 1 MiB, per-call bodyStream(long), per-mount .bodyLimit (IR-PROXY-001 AC-3 / FR-PROXY-002 AC-3).
No requirement bounds the mount limit by the app limit: FR-PROXY-002 AC-3 checks bodyLimit only against 1..1073741824 at call time.
Example Proxy p = Proxy.to(url).maxConcurrent(16) with p and p.retries(0) sharing 16.

Compatibility note names both 0.12.0 behaviour changes (413 mapping, package move with import change).

evidence.detail: docs/spec/04.http-core.srs.md:4800 IR-HTTP-011 AC-2: "`Class.forName("com.snoworca.naruserve.internal.BodyTooLargeException")` throws `ClassNotFoundException`, and the `NaruServe-api` JAR holds no class of that name" vs docs/spec/07.json.srs.md:270 FR-JSON-001 AC-9 (unexpired, verified): "(its internal `BodyTooLargeException`, an `IOException` that a codec such as Gson may wrap)" and docs/spec/04.http-core.srs.md:2231-2232 FR-HTTP-020 AC-3/AC-4: "throws the internal over-limit `IOException` subclass" / "throws the same internal over-limit `IOException` subclass"; FR-HTTP-020 Trace Links row docs/spec/04.http-core.srs.md:2263: "| Code | NaruServe-api/src/main/java/com/snoworca/naruserve/internal/BodyTooLargeException.java | implements | - |", a file IR-HTTP-011 deletes.

findings.description: The writer kept FR-HTTP-020 AC-3/AC-4 and FR-JSON-001 AC-9 unexpired on the ground that their rule stays true. The rule does, but each criterion still calls the over-limit class internal, and FR-HTTP-020 still traces to internal/BodyTooLargeException.java, which IR-HTTP-011 AC-2 requires to be absent. After 0.12.0 these verified criteria name a class that cannot exist.

evidence.detail: docs/spec/15.release.srs.md:56 FR-REL-001 Requirement: "generate a CycloneDX SBOM for each published module (the nine JAR modules and, when it is included, the `NaruServe-android` AAR)" vs docs/spec/15.release.srs.md:1665 FR-REL-006 AC-5: "one for each of the ten entries of `naruModules` and, when it is included, `NaruServe-android`".

findings.description: Only FR-REL-001 AC-1 was expired. The statement still defines the published modules as nine JAR modules plus the AAR, which contradicts the ten-module SBOM rule of FR-REL-006 AC-5 that succeeds it.

evidence.detail: docs/spec/04.http-core.srs.md:5359 FR-HTTP-035 AC-4: "the first listener's exception is logged through the app logger" vs docs/spec/04.http-core.srs.md:5387 Implementation Notes: "Back the listeners with the public `common.AbortListeners` (... failures isolated through `SafeCallbacks`)"; code NaruServe-api/src/main/java/com/snoworca/naruserve/common/SafeCallbacks.java run(): `try { callback.run(); } catch (Throwable ignored) { // Resource notification failures must not interrupt the caller's cleanup. }` and AbortListeners.notifyListener calls SafeCallbacks.run, so it logs nothing.

findings.description: The implementation path the requirement prescribes discards a listener exception without logging, so following the note fails AC-4's logging clause (design D-028). The note needs to say that each listener is wrapped to log through the app logger before AbortListeners isolates it, or that AbortListeners is not reused as is.
